title: Lucy and Her Cat
text:
Lucy has a cat. Her cat is white and very soft. Every day, Lucy gives her cat fresh water. The cat likes to sleep on the sofa.

Lucy also brushes her cat every week. This keeps the fur clean. When the cat is sick, Lucy takes it to the vet. Lucy loves her cat very much.

questions.text: How often does Lucy brush her cat?
Why does Lucy take her cat to the vet when it is sick?
How does Lucy probably feel about her cat?
options: She does not care about it
She cares about it a lot

vocabulary.definition: new and clean, not old or dirty
cleans or smooths something with a brush

paragraph_translations: Lucy ma kota. Jej kot jest biały i bardzo miękki. Codziennie Lucy daje kotu świeżą wodę. Kot lubi spać na kanapie.
Lucy czesze też swojego kota co tydzień. Dzięki temu sierść jest czysta. Kiedy kot jest chory, Lucy zabiera go do weterynarza. Lucy bardzo kocha swojego kota.
